source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 3, 12. Πᾶν αὐτοῦ, φησί, βέλος ἐκἐνωσε κατ' ἐμοῦ, τὴν ἐμὴν τιτρώσκων ἐπιθυμίαν καὶ μὴ συγχωρῶν μοι πράττειν ὡς βούλομαι.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Every arrow of his, he says, he emptied against me, wounding my desire and not allowing me to act as I wish.
pass_b_english: Every arrow of his, he says, he emptied against me, wounding my desire and not allowing me to act as I wish (Lamentations 3:12).

choices.why: Origen’s reading of nephroi/arrows in Lam 3:13.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations disclosed in translator_notes.
